items.title: AgentGuard – a QA engine that sits between AI coding agents and LLMs
items.raw_excerpt:
AI coding agents are great at generating code, but terrible at respecting architecture.
We kept getting code that looked correct but didn’t type-check, had hallucinated imports,
or ignored project boundaries. AgentGuard is an open-source quality-assurance engine that sits between an AI coding agent
and the LLM. It enforces a top-down generation pipeline: Skeleton → Contracts → Wiring → Logic Each stage constrains the next, and we validate syntax, imports, linting and types before
any human sees the code. The LLM also self-reviews its output against explicit criteria. AgentGuard supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline) and tracks token cost
per model and run. Python 3.11+, MIT licensed.

items.title: Discussion: What would an AI government look like?
items.raw_excerpt: I haven't really heard anyone bring up this topic, so I thought I'd open a discussion here. To me the appeals are obvious. AI governments could theoretically be incorruptible, tireless, consistent, and capable of processing vastly more information than human bureaucracies. They wouldn't accept bribes, play favorites for personal gain, or make decisions based on re-election anxiety. Policy could be optimized across decades rather than election cycles. Practically, I don't know how it would work. What do people here think?

excerpt_i18n.en: Fan Haoqiang is a very humorous person. When we asked him what embodied AI needs to solve in the next decade, he joked that robots might awaken and wipe out humanity, leaving no next decade. This is, of course, a jest, as exploring industry development inevitably involves some sci-fi imagination. In his view, AI should be a lifelong career. After all, he won a gold medal in the International Olympiad in Informatics in his first year of high school and became a genuine AI researcher starting from his second year. The name Yuanli Lingji may sound unfamiliar, but its origins are notable—it is an embodied AI company spun off from Megvii, founded by Megvii's co-founder and several of its earliest employees. Shortly after its establishment, the company raised nearly 1 billion yuan across two funding rounds. Our curiosity about Yuanli Lingji centers on several points: Are they focused on developing models or physical entities? What is their business model? As a new company emerging from Megvii, what advantages do they possess? And how can they stand out in the current competitive landscape? Having interacted with countless clients during his time at Megvii, Fan Haoqiang's understanding of embodied AI carries a strong "Megvii" flavor. From the very first day of entrepreneurship, Fan Haoqiang keenly felt the strong demand from clients for embodied AI. However, he regrets that many of these demands cannot be met at present. The capabilities of robots remain extremely limited, while the precision and efficiency requirements of production lines are astonishingly high. In the past, Megvii achieved facial recognition accuracy to 11 nines, but now, even the simplest robotic grasping task may have a success rate of less than half.

items.title: 北大林宙辰团队：从最优传输角度训练时序预测模型 丨ICLR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 在时间序列预测研究中，一个耐人寻味的现象长期存在： 一方面，模型结构不断演进，从循环网络到 Transformer，再到频域与混合结构；另一方面，几乎所有方法在训练阶段依赖同一类损失函数，即以均方误差（MSE）为代表的点对点误差。 这使得时间序列预测在方法论层面呈现出一种隐性的停滞，即研究重心持续向模型表达能力倾斜，而对损失函数所隐含的统计假设缺乏系统反思。 点对点误差的核心假设在于，标签序列中的各时间步可被视为给定历史条件下相互独立的预测对象。然而，这一假设与时间序列数据的生成机制之间始终存在张力。 真实世界中的时间序列由随机过程演化而来，不同时间点之间存在显著的相关关系。将多步预测问题拆解为一组独立的回归任务，不可避免地为损失函数引入了结构性偏差，使模型难以学习标签序列的整体形态、相关结构以及条件依赖关系。 针对这一问题，北京大学林宙辰团队深入剖析了此类结构性偏差的成因。在此基础上，团队提出了 DistDF：一种通过联合分布对齐训练预测模型的损失函数。DistDF 的提出不仅为时间序列预测提供了一种新的损失函数设计思路，也在更一般的意义上，对序列建模中“应当优化什么”这一长期被默认的问题给出了新的回答。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.24574v1 当独立性假设被实验证伪之后 当前时间序列预测领域的主流方法普遍采用逐时间点的均方误差（MSE）作为损失函数： $$\mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}} = \|\mathbf{y} - g_\theta(\mathbf{x})\|^2=\sum_{t=1}^\mathrm{T}\left(y_t-g_{\theta,t}(\mathbf{x})\right)$$ $$\mathcal{L}_\mathrm{MSE}$$隐式地做了独立性假设：在给定历史序列的条件下，标签序列各时间点

excerpt_i18n.en: In time series forecasting research, a thought-provoking phenomenon has long persisted: on one hand, model architectures have continuously evolved, from recurrent networks to Transformers, and further to frequency-domain and hybrid structures; on the other hand, almost all methods rely on the same class of loss functions during training, namely pointwise errors represented by mean squared error (MSE). This creates an implicit stagnation at the methodological level in time series forecasting, where research focus consistently leans toward model expressiveness, while lacking systematic reflection on the statistical assumptions embedded in loss functions. The core assumption of pointwise error is that each time step in the label sequence can be treated as an independent prediction target given historical conditions. However, there has always been tension between this assumption and the generative mechanism of time series data. Real-world time series evolve from stochastic processes, exhibiting significant correlations between different time points. Decomposing multi-step forecasting into a set of independent regression tasks inevitably introduces structural bias into the loss function, making it difficult for models to learn the overall shape, correlation structure, and conditional dependencies of the label sequence. To address this issue, the team led by Zhouchen Lin at Peking University has deeply analyzed the causes of such structural bias. Building on this, the team proposed DistDF: a loss function for training forecasting models through joint distribution alignment. The introduction of DistDF not only provides a new design perspective for loss functions in time series forecasting but also, in a broader sense, challenges the long-defaulted question of "what should be optimized" in sequence modeling.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la investigación de predicción de series temporales, existe un fenómeno intrigante y persistente: por un lado, la estructura de los modelos evoluciona constantemente, desde redes recurrentes hasta Transformer, y luego a estructuras en el dominio de la frecuencia y mixtas; por otro lado, casi todos los métodos dependen en la fase de entrenamiento de la misma clase de funciones de pérdida, es decir, el error punto a punto representado por el error cuadrático medio (MSE). Esto hace que la predicción de series temporales presente a nivel metodológico un estancamiento implícito, donde el enfoque de investigación sigue inclinándose hacia la capacidad expresiva de los modelos, mientras que se carece de una reflexión sistemática sobre las suposiciones estadísticas implícitas en las funciones de pérdida. La suposición central del error punto a punto radica en que cada paso de tiempo en la secuencia de etiquetas puede considerarse independiente entre sí bajo condiciones históricas dadas.

items.title: 谷歌版「豆包手机」发布，GUI 操作实现跨 App 代办
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，三星最新发布的 Galaxy S26 系列进一步强化与Gemini 的系统级整合，推出Gemini智能手机助手帮助用户自动完成任务，能力和国内“豆包手机助手”相近。据介绍，用户可通过长按侧键在系统层面唤醒 Gemini，并将其作为“代办任务”的入口，由Gemini自动完成多步骤操作，用户在此期间仍可继续使用手机，并可从通知栏实时查看进度、介入或停止任务。据悉，Gemini 手机助手的部分任务执行能力由 GUI 方案实现。 在发布相关合作进展时，谷歌安卓生态系统总裁萨米尔·萨马特（Sameer Samat）表示，安卓正从传统操作系统演变为“真正理解并为你服务的智能系统”。谈及 Gemini 手机助手，他称业内称之为“智能体（agentic AI）”，但他更愿意把它概括为“把事情搞定”。他认为，后台任务执行能减少应用切换与手动协调，让流程更顺畅，同时仍保留用户的可见性与控制权。同时，他也表示这项技术正在兴起，重要的是怎么拥抱。

excerpt_i18n.zh: 近日，三星最新发布的 Galaxy S26 系列进一步强化与Gemini 的系统级整合，推出Gemini智能手机助手帮助用户自动完成任务，能力和国内“豆包手机助手”相近。据介绍，用户可通过长按侧键在系统层面唤醒 Gemini，并将其作为“代办任务”的入口，由Gemini自动完成多步骤操作，用户在此期间仍可继续使用手机，并可从通知栏实时查看进度、介入或停止任务。据悉，Gemini 手机助手的部分任务执行能力由 GUI 方案实现。 在发布相关合作进展时，谷歌安卓生态系统总裁萨米尔·萨马特（Sameer Samat）表示，安卓正从传统操作系统演变为“真正理解并为你服务的智能系统”。谈及 Gemini 手机助手，他称业内称之为“智能体（agentic AI）”，但他更愿意把它概括为“把事情搞定”。他认为，后台任务执行能减少应用切换与手动协调，让流程更顺畅，同时仍保留用户的可见性与控制权。同时，他也表示这项技术正在兴起，重要的是怎么拥抱。
excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Samsung's latest Galaxy S26 series has further enhanced its system-level integration with Gemini, introducing the Gemini smartphone assistant to help users automate tasks, with capabilities similar to the domestic "Doubao Phone Assistant." It is reported that users can activate Gemini at the system level by long-pressing the side key, using it as an entry point for "to-do tasks." Gemini can automatically complete multi-step operations, allowing users to continue using their phones during this time and monitor progress, intervene, or stop tasks in real-time via the notification bar. It is understood that some of the task execution capabilities of the Gemini phone assistant are implemented through GUI solutions.  

When announcing the progress of this collaboration, Sameer Samat, President of Google's Android Ecosystem, stated that Android is evolving from a traditional operating system into "an intelligent system that truly understands and serves you." Regarding the Gemini phone assistant, he mentioned that the industry refers to it as "agentic AI," but he prefers to summarize it as "getting things done." He believes that background task execution can reduce app switching and manual coordination, making processes smoother while still preserving user visibility and control. He also noted that this technology is on the rise, and the key is how to embrace it.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la última serie Galaxy S26 de Samsung ha reforzado aún más la integración a nivel de sistema con Gemini, presentando el asistente de smartphone Gemini para ayudar a los usuarios a completar tareas automáticamente, con capacidades similares al "Asistente de Móvil Doubao" en China. Según se informa, los usuarios pueden activar Gemini a nivel del sistema manteniendo presionada la tecla lateral y utilizarlo como punto de entrada para "tareas pendientes", donde Gemini completa automáticamente operaciones de múltiples pasos. Durante este proceso, los usuarios pueden seguir usando el teléfono y monitorear el progreso en tiempo real desde la barra de notificaciones, intervenir o detener la tarea. items.title: OpenAI Codex and Figma launch seamless code-to-design experience
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI and Figma launch a new Codex integration that connects code and design, enabling teams to move between implementation and the Figma canvas to iterate and ship faster.

title_i18n.en: OpenAI Codex and Figma launch seamless code-to-design experience
title_i18n.zh: OpenAI Codex与Figma推出无缝代码转设计体验。
title_i18n.es: OpenAI Codex y Figma lanzan una experiencia fluida de código a diseño.

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI and Figma launch a new Codex integration that connects code and design, enabling teams to move between implementation and the Figma canvas to iterate and ship faster.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI与Figma推出全新Codex集成方案，打通代码与设计环节，助力团队在编程实现与Figma设计界面间无缝切换，从而加速迭代与交付流程。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI y Figma lanzan una nueva integración de Codex que conecta código y diseño, permitiendo a los equipos moverse entre la implementación y el lienzo de Figma para iterar y lanzar más rápido.
